# Intuition Spinner

> Intuition Spinner is a free, peaceful reflection app created by The AlcheMind Studio. It offers 50 quiet prompts that help people pause, notice their surroundings, and reconnect with themselves.

## What the app does

- A visitor activates one circular spinner to receive a reflection.
- Each reflection contains a one-word theme, a thoughtful question, and one small physical or observational invitation.
- Optional ambient music and light or dark display modes support the experience.
- No account, payment, or personal information is required.

## Reflection guide

The site includes a short, practical guide to self-reflection questions at https://intuition-spinner.vercel.app/reflection-prompts/. It explains how to use a single prompt without turning reflection into another task to complete.

## Creator

Intuition Spinner is an AlcheMind Studio project by Alin.
